title: feat(colorpicker): add Delete and I keyboard shortcuts to the editor

proposed_comments.title: Avoid a forced layout on every Delete keypress

confidence.rationale: The pinned source proves that every qualifying Delete invocation synchronously forces a ListView layout after the collection update. The repeated-key path is explicit, but no timing profile establishes user-visible impact.

proposed_comments.body:
### Avoid a forced layout on every Delete keypress

**Severity:** `low`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/colorPicker/ColorPickerUI/Views/ColorEditorView.xaml.cs`, `DeleteAccelerator_Invoked`.

**Problem:** `HistoryColors.UpdateLayout()` forces a synchronous layout pass after each Delete event. The Delete accelerator invokes this handler for each keypress, including key-repeat while removing swatches consecutively.

**Why it matters:** This adds UI-thread measure/arrange work to the repeated-deletion path and may make rapid clearing less responsive.

**Suggested change:** Restore focus without forcing a layout pass, or defer focus restoration until after the collection update. Preserve the ability to press or hold Delete to remove consecutive swatches.

**Verification:** Hold Delete over multiple selected swatches and repeat after a single selection; confirm each intended swatch is removed and keyboard focus remains on the list. Verify that focus restoration does not require a synchronous layout on every repeat.
